purpose: Decision-readiness table for the landing page: one row per requirement, the gate that blocks it, and the number that would clear it. Requirement text and status are copied at build time from requirements/data/requirements.json so they cannot drift; this file supplies only the gate and the clearing number. Every number here is a pre-registered project threshold quoted from an existing register (origination/results/validation-w10.json gates_doc, ledger/data/demotion-rules.json, market/data/decision-gate.json); where no pre-registered number exists the cell is null and flagged. No number is invented.

number_sources.G3: origination/results/validation-w10.json gates_doc: 'G3 sample size >= 80 games (singles) | >= 40 independent pairs (parlays) | >= 100 player-games (props)'
number_sources.G7: origination/results/validation-w10.json gates_doc: 'G7 calibration, probability products only: expected calibration error (5 bins) <= 0.10'
number_sources.D6: ledger/data/demotion-rules.json rule D6: demote when p_holm >= 0.05
number_sources.Q-04: market/data/decision-gate.json Q-04 discovery plan: collect postgame Game Books; 'after 6-8 weeks you have a measured backup-started event set'
number_sources.Q-01: market/data/decision-gate.json Q-01 discovery plan: 'score 60+ priced games'

rows.gate: None - MET (the register itself is the deliverable)
rows.note: Self-referential requirement; no external number applies.

rows.gate: Operator review - every suggestion row is still OPEN (market SG-01..SG-12, ledger SG-L1..SG-L7, requirements register 16 rows)
rows.clearing_number: 16 review decisions recorded (one per requirements-register suggestion row)
rows.number_source: requirements/data/suggestions.json row count; the decision itself is the operator's
rows.note: The section exists (MET); the decisions do not. Nothing is implemented before a choice.

rows.gate: None for the register - MET; OPEN rows wait on data no official page publishes (depth order, open/close prices)
rows.note: Answerable-now rows are answered; the rest carry explicit discovery plans (market Q-01..Q-11).

rows.gate: G3 chronological evaluation and calibration; market comparison is now possible (ledger price store records the published FanDuel lines, 2026-11-15)
rows.clearing_number: >= 80 settled single-game forecasts before any calibration claim (G3 minimum)
rows.note: 15 Week 9 lines were graded out of sample (spread MAE 10.65); n=15 cannot separate skill from luck.

rows.gate: G3 chronological train / validation / untouched holdout, frozen before evaluation
rows.clearing_number: >= 80 games per single-bet signal family (G3 minimum), scored with the pre-registered proper-score test
rows.note: Only the point-spread and total families have any out-of-sample result today (n=15).

rows.gate: G7 (calibration) and G8 (prospective ledger); plus at least one strategy passing every applicable gate
rows.clearing_number: 1 strategy with signal PASS over >= 80 games and p_holm < 0.05 (D6 demotion threshold); ECE <= 0.10 (G7)
rows.note: 0 of 14 registered strategies pass today; the leaderboard is empty by design, not by failure.

rows.gate: G6 joint distribution plus the operator's void/push rules; multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence (joint-evidence gate)
rows.clearing_number: >= 40 settled independent parlay pairs (G3 minimum) with a directly validated joint probability per combo
rows.note: Prop combos additionally need the >= 100 player-games player-level, event-aligned dataset, which does not exist yet.

rows.gate: None - MET (gates fail closed; missing evidence can never count as a pass)
rows.note: The gates are not failing because they are mis-specified; they fail because the evidence does not exist.

rows.gate: Leg-level dependence data (player-level, same game, same threshold, same pregame timestamp) does not exist; two Next Gen Stats weeks are missing
rows.clearing_number: n >= 100 player-games per prop leg (G3 minimum) and 0 missing Next Gen Stats weeks (currently 2 missing)
rows.note: Team-level correlations publish n and Fisher-z intervals (independently recomputed, 11/11 match) but cannot price a combo.

rows.gate: Finite-sample bound only - 'removal of luck' cannot be cleared as worded; luck is bounded, not removed
rows.note: No number clears this requirement as literally worded. The luck decomposition panel (60% of win-% variance attributed to luck in the 136-game log) and the anti-luck dashboard state what can be bounded: >= 80 settled games (G3) shrink the bound but never eliminate it.

rows.gate: None - MET (official injury report captured with practice status and game status kept distinct)
rows.note: Final inactives for Sunday and Monday games are published later and are labelled pending; the report is a dated snapshot.

rows.gate: No official pregame starter designation exists - the nfl.com depth-chart URL returns 404 and the roster publishes a transaction status, not an order
rows.clearing_number: 6-8 weeks of postgame Game Books joined to pregame injury reports (Q-04) before a measured 'backup started' event set exists
rows.note: Pregame 2nd/3rd/4th-string labelling is NOT POSSIBLE from official sources today; postgame Game Books name the 11 starters after the game. Depth is modelled from playing time, never from jersey order.
